title: cwa-originals-2006-diva
label: Corina

won.source: Battle of the Warriors 2007 CWA Edition, 13 January 2007: Corina wins the sixteen-woman Diva Gauntlet, whose winner is the first CWA Diva champion.

how: Won the Diva Gauntlet, pinning Kathy Smith.
note: Retains over Cordelia Parizi on 20 January 2007; the ladder match of 3 February 2007 ends with Corina and Kelly Buchanan declared co-holders, and Corina defends the belt alone on 17 February 2007. No later held card shows a change.

title: cwa-originals-2006-womens
label: Sammy Jo Johnson

won.source: Warriors, 10 February 2007: Sammy Jo Johnson wins the five-woman elimination match for the women’s title Myst vacated.

how: Won a five-woman elimination match, pinning Kathy Smith and then Xandra.
note: Myst, the champion at Battle of the Warriors 2007, announces on 27 January 2007 that she is vacating it; no later held card shows a change.
